title: Radix-Pass Arguments
statement: An argument record for a radix pass consists of natural numbers $w$, $perm$, $key$, $stride$, $off$, $nb$, $cnt$, and $R$. Here $w$ is the number of indices; the index list begins at cell $perm$, with the next $w$ cells reserved as scratch space; the key of index $i$ is stored at cell $key+i\cdot stride+off$; every key is less than $nb$; the $nb+1$ counters begin at cell $cnt$; and only cells at or beyond $perm$ among the first $R$ cells may change.
